repaired_reason: The adversarial tier was lost when the OpenAI key was rotated mid-run on 2026-08-09 and was re-run in full on 2026-10-25 against the same dataset, prompts and models. The surviving easy and multi-hop runs are from 2026-08-08/09. The tiers are therefore not contemporaneous: the web moved between the two dates, and adv-001 run 1 — the single adversarial run that survived the rotation — was re-run and replaced rather than mixed with the new ones, so every adversarial row here matches the trace committed beside it.
